text:
Jules (Design): Pushing a new compact row concept for the SLO/alert rules editor. Two open questions: 1) show channels inline as slim tokens or collapse to a single 'channels' affordance; 2) where to surface suppression duration copy (inline vs a dedicated little modal). Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE

Arman (PM): We need one-line scanability in the rule list. If we go tokens inline, keep them extremely small or truncate. I prefer a single collapsed "channels" control that expands.

Rae (Eng): From perf standpoint, render the full channel lists lazily in the popover. Inline tokens for thousands of rules will kill paint. Also avoid measuring layout for each token; use transforms for hover states.

Keiko (Accessibility): A11y notes: the expanded channels panel should be accessible via keyboard and expose `aria-label="Channels for rule <name>"`. If suppression options open a dialog, use `role=dialog` and return focus to the trigger when closed. For inline updates to the sample text, add an `aria-live="polite"` region.

Marco (Product): Copy suggestion: replace "suppress until" with clearer phrasing depending on scope: if it's per-rule use "mute notifications until", if it's channel-scoped use "mute channel deliveries until". Also show a compact frequency hint: e.g., "~3 alerts/day" when we can estimate.

Tess (Design): I prototyped a tiny chevron that opens a collapsed 'advanced sample' panel containing voice (Ops / On-call / Manager), time-of-day context, and suppression preview. Hidden by default to keep rows clean.

Jules (Design): For channel indicators, I'm trying a numeric pill like "2 channels" + an overflow avatar when >3. Hover opens popover with the list and toggle switches. Thoughts?

Rae (Eng): Numeric pill + anchored popover is solid. Make sure `aria-expanded` toggles and that popover content is in the DOM only when open to reduce memory. We'll handle keyboard trapping in the component lib.

Keiko (Accessibility): Popover specifics: use `aria-modal="false"` but trap focus. Support Escape to close and announce "Channels panel closed" via `aria-live` so AT users know context returned. Also ensure contrast for the numeric pill meets AA — current mock drops under contrast when small.

Marco (Product): UX nit: sample preview should include the exact delivery text we send to a channel, plus an optional short explanation line like "sent to: #infra (channel)". Helps PMs and on-call to validate.

Tess (Design): CSS note: small filled tokens fail AA on our dark theme. I'll switch to a stroke-only micro-pill at small sizes and keep filled pills for larger badges. Example: `border: 1px solid var(--muted)` and `background: transparent`.

Jules (Design): Accessibility + copy + perf acknowledged. Plan: iterate to compact row with expand, numeric channel pill -> popover, hidden advanced sample chevron, and clarified suppress copy. I'll update Figma and add the a11y checklist to the spec doc.

Arman (PM): Thanks — please tag the SRE reviewer when you post the next frames.

Rae (Eng): +1 from eng, will prototype lazy render & keyboard flow.
